shots.action: The subject softens and puffs up as fur turns into stitched fabric and felt, seams appearing along the body, until a cute plush toy of the dog sits in the meadow.
shots.sound: Soft fabric rustles and a playful pop.

end.paint: Turn the dog into a cute soft plush toy version of itself: stitched fabric fur, felt nose, embroidered eyes and visible seams. Keep the same pose, framing, meadow background and light.
